# Botanica by Collective Space

> Australia's largest freelance-only hair and beauty salon. Botanica rents private
> workstations to independent hair stylists, colourists, hair extension specialists
> and nail technicians in Southport on the Gold Coast, Queensland — and hires out its
> 300m² space for industry events, masterclasses and photoshoots.

This file summarises the site for AI assistants and answer engines. Everything below is
accurate as at August 2026. For anything time-sensitive — current availability, exact
pricing for an event, or which stylists are taking new clients — call 0437 125 007.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Botanica by Collective Space
- **Type:** Freelance-only hair and beauty salon; chair/space rental, plus venue hire
- **Address:** Shop 7/19 Brolga Avenue, Cnr Warehouse Road, Southport QLD 4215, Australia
- **Phone:** 0437 125 007 (+61 437 125 007)
- **Opening hours:** Tuesday to Saturday, 9am–5pm, by appointment. Closed Sunday and Monday.
  Events and education sessions can be arranged any day, at any time.
- **Chair hire from:** AUD $130 per day
- **Size:** 300m², 30 stylist workstations, 8 wash beds, 2 waiting/lounge areas
- **Creatives on site:** 17 independent professionals
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/botanica_by_collective_space/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/botanicabycollectivespace

## What makes Botanica different

Botanica is not a traditional salon that employs stylists. Every professional working
there is self-employed and rents their own space. They set their own schedules, keep
control of their own pricing, services and branding, and book their own clients directly.
Botanica provides the premises, facilities and community.

## What's included with a chair

Power, water and free WiFi; a coffee bar stocked with coffee, tea, still water and treats
for clients; a dedicated colour room with lockable personal storage for products, colours
and trolleys; a stylist-only relax room with a full kitchen; a laundry room with washing
machine, dryer and towel storage; and wheelchair-accessible bathrooms. Free on-site parking.

## Venue and event hire

The 300m² space is available for hire for product launches, industry networking nights,
educational masterclasses, brand training, photoshoots, pop-ups and celebrations. It
includes a large welcome area, two lounge areas, two catering rooms for professional
caterers, rear roller-door access and free parking. Hire includes glassware, catering
serving-ware and platters, ice tubs, tables and tablecloths, 16 low stools, a Sonos sound
system (or Bluetooth for your own audio), an on-site coordinator, space preparation before
and after, and cleaning and rubbish removal. Event pricing is quoted per booking.

## Disciplines practised on site

Cutting, colour and colour correction, balayage and blondes, keratin smoothing treatments,
hair extensions (tape, slimline weft and keratin bond), bridal and formal upstyles, colour
analysis, organic and holistic haircare, and builder-gel manicures and nail art.

## Common questions

**How much does it cost to rent a space?** From $130 per day, with utilities and shared
facilities included.

**Do I need an existing client base?** Most creatives arrive with a following, but Botanica
is happy to talk with anyone building theirs.

**Can I book a haircut at Botanica?** Yes — but you book directly with an individual
stylist, not with the salon. Each stylist's profile on the Our Stylists page lists their
phone number and, where they use one, an online booking link.

**Is the venue available for hire?** Yes, on any day and at any time, by arrangement.

**Is there parking?** Yes, plenty of free on-site parking, with rear roller-door access.
